scope: Trusted managed fixtures only. Compilation/reflection is verified. uniform.comp exercises common B1 Uniform/Storage creation and binding contracts. sampled.comp and sampled_float.comp exercise RGBA8/RGBA16F sampled-image/View/sampler bindings through private dispatch. General image/raster D3D12 Graph execution and image equivalence remain later B1 work (renderer-7ft.2.3 and renderer-7ft.2.4).

coordinates.input: Same model positions and column-major clip_from_model bytes as Vulkan
coordinates.vertex_y: Negate clip-space Y in both generated vertex shaders to match positive-height Vulkan viewport orientation with a positive D3D12 viewport
coordinates.raster: Normal Z, clear depth 1, LESS, cull NONE, blending disabled; front-face/culling equivalence is not established
coordinates.pixel: Top-left image coordinates and pixel-center SV_Position.xy; integer truncation selects the same texel
coordinates.color: The older fixed fixtures use linear RGBA8_UNORM without filtering. sampled.comp uses nearest/clamp RGBA8 sampling and UNORM packing. sampled_float.comp uses nearest/clamp RGBA16F sampling and preserves all FP32 result bits. No sRGB conversion, tone mapping, or general HDR renderer is implemented by these fixtures.

vulkan_bindings: set0/binding0 one separate float texture2D sampled image
set1/binding0 std430 writeonly storage buffer, uvec4 value[4] at byte 0, stride 16, 64 bytes
d3d12_active_bindings: u0/space1 RWByteAddressBuffer, Store4 at bytes 0, 16, 32 and 48
sampled_float.comp.image: An initialized R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT / R16G16B16A16_FLOAT 2D image; the acceptance fixture is 2x2, one mip/layer/sample. Storage values convert to FP32 sample results without shaderFloat16 arithmetic or 16-bit shader storage features.
sampled_float.comp.sampler: Same separate normalized-coordinate nearest/clamp-to-edge sampler at explicit LOD 0 as sampled.comp; no comparison or anisotropy.
sampled_float.comp.output: Four full RGBA sample vectors in row-major texel order, floatBitsToUint/asuint bitcast into uvec4[4]. Negative and above-one values are retained; no clamp, UNORM packing, half arithmetic, or float-to-integer numeric conversion.
sampled_float.comp.versions: The newer image reverses all 16 component positions, preserving each little-endian half encoding. The expected 16 FP32 words reverse in the same order. No subnormal, NaN, infinity, or negative zero is used.
sampled_float.comp.bounds: Exactly one workgroup. The storage descriptor has at least 64 logical bytes; only its first 64 bytes are initialized by the shader. Public Graph dispatch and general HDR/depth rendering are subsequent work.
sampled_float.comp.verification: The managed checker verifies the shared sampled interface and literal uvec4 array[4], offset 0, stride 16, block size 64. All 16 sampled FP32 components must match the independently specified expected words on both APIs; shader reflection alone does not establish format support, behavior or arbitrary shader safety.

vulkan_bindings: set0/binding0 one separate texture2D sampled image
set1/binding0 std430 writeonly storage buffer, one uvec4 at byte 0, 16 bytes
sampled.comp.image: A complete initialized linear RGBA8_UNORM 2D image; the acceptance fixture is 2x2 with one mip and layer. No format reinterpretation or sRGB conversion.
sampled.comp.sampler: Separate sampler with normalized coordinates, min/mag nearest, mip nearest, clamp-to-edge on all axes, no comparison/anisotropy, LOD zero. Actual textureLod/SampleLevel keeps it active in both binaries.
sampled.comp.packing: Each textureLod at explicit LOD 0 is packUnorm4x8 encoded: R is the least-significant byte, followed by G, B, A. Four packed texels form the output uvec4. Outside UVs exercise clamp; off-center interior UVs distinguish nearest from linear.
sampled.comp.bounds: Host dispatches exactly one workgroup. The storage range has at least 16 bytes; only its first 16 bytes are initialized by the shader. No arbitrary shader, public dispatch, mip/layer traversal, or general Graph integration is provided.
sampled.comp.verification: managed-abi.ps1 checks both reflected interfaces, including the active separate sampler, 2D float sampled image, and write-only 16-byte storage output. The known 2x2 fixture must return the same 16 RGBA bytes on both APIs in little-endian u32 output order; actual filtering, addressing, orientation, packing and lifetime remain GPU acceptance obligations. Reflection does not prove arbitrary shader safety.

vulkan_bindings: set0/binding0 std140 uniform buffer, one uvec4 at byte 0, 16 bytes
set1/binding0 std430 writeonly storage buffer, one uvec4 at byte 0, 16 bytes
d3d12_active_bindings: b0/space0 cbuffer, one uint4 at byte 0, 16 logical bytes
u0/space1 RWByteAddressBuffer storage output, Store4 at byte 0
uniform.comp.bounds: Private acceptance dispatches exactly one workgroup using publicly created buffers/bindings. Both ranges contain at least 16 bytes; only the first 16 descriptor bytes are initialized by the shader. General Graph execution is subsequent work.
uniform.comp.uniform_allocation: The logical 16-byte ABI does not replace Vulkan uniform offset/range limits or D3D12 CBV placement/range alignment and native allocation requirements.
uniform.comp.verification: managed-abi.ps1 mechanically checks SPIRV-Cross JSON and DXC reflected resource registers, counts, local size, uniform member type/offset and logical block size. The managed source and GPU byte round-trip establish behavior; reflection is not a proof of arbitrary shader safety.

image.comp.capability: D3D12_FORMAT_SUPPORT2_UAV_TYPED_LOAD and UAV_TYPED_STORE for DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM; DXIL declares Typed UAV Load Additional Formats
image.comp.constant_binding: DXC assigned and reflected b0; SPIRV-Cross emits an unregistered cbuffer
image.comp.bounds: Host must require equal nonzero source/destination extents; shader guards destination bounds for ceil-divided dispatch
image.comp.choice: Keep default storage-image UAV mapping; do not use SPIRV-Cross's type-system-sensitive --hlsl-nonwritable-uav-texture-as-srv option

mesh.vert.constant_binding: DXC assigned and reflected b0/space0; SPIRV-Cross emits an unregistered cbuffer
mesh.vert.matrix: Generated row_major float4x4 and mul(position, matrix) together preserve the original column-major host payload. Do not transpose or repack CPU bytes.
mesh.vert.output: TEXCOORD0 linear float4 color and SV_Position

composite.vert.input: SV_VertexID, fullscreen non-indexed triangle, vertex count 3, start vertex 0

composite.frag.sampler: SPIRV-Cross splits the combined sampler declaration, but texelFetch becomes Texture2D.Load. DXC removes unused s0; the checked-in reflection verifies no active sampler.
composite.frag.output: SV_Target0 float4, source and destination extents must match

constant_allocation: Logical member offsets and sizes do not replace D3D12 root-constant/CBV placement and range requirements. Product runtime chooses and validates the binding in later tasks.
verification: Regeneration compares pinned tools, source/SPIR-V hashes, generated HLSL, validated DXIL, and DXC signature/binding/offset reflection. Nonidentity MVP, off-center geometry, depth, colors, and every output pixel still require real GPU comparison.
